1879052532.name: Rain of Thorns
1879052532.desc: Rains thorn arrows down upon your enemies, allowing you to pin multiple targets.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.

1879097204.name: Dog-speech
1879097204.desc: Summons a little dog-friend to brighten your day.

1879110132.name: Soliloquy of Spirit
1879110132.desc: Your tune is like a slow burning Soliloquy that keeps the spirit bolstered for a time. This is one of the few minstrel morale heals that can be used on the move.

1879146740.name: That Which Does Not Kill Us
1879146740.desc: That which does not kill us makes us stronger. Allies deal increased damage until they are attacked. This first attack is negated and the damage bonus is replaced by a potent heal.

1879157620.name: Threatening Riposte
1879157620.desc: A self-buff that generates threat when struck.

1879176052.name: Return to Mirkwood
1879176052.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Elven forces in Mirkwood, you're able to quickly return to Emyn Lûm in Mirkwood. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879191028.name: Dúnadan's Strike
1879191028.desc: A Ranger is both master of blade and bow. This attack will stun the opponent.

1879191796.name: Herbalist
1879191796.desc: Call upon your Soldier to assist you in battle, who has trained as a Herbalist.\n<rgb=#FF0000>Can only be used inside of a Skirmish. Can be used while in combat.</rgb>

1879198324.name: Friend of Small Hunters (Tundra Lynx)
1879198324.desc: Summons a lynx companion.\n\nThe lynx is a stealthy hunter.

1879208436.name: Treasure Laden Goat
1879208436.desc: A goat laden with the spoils of a treasure hunt!

1879214580.name: Fierce Resolve
1879214580.desc: Drains morale from nearby enemies over time to heal the Warden.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879222132.name: Improved Hedge
1879222132.desc: You are able to make a melee attack while regaining control of your weapons. This allows you to Parry regardless of stance. You also maximize the use of your armour increasing the value for a short time and gain more critical defence.

1879248372.name: Noble Arrow - Fire
1879248372.desc: The Noble Arrow of Fire, once launched, will seek to injure your foe with critical intent.

1879254260.name: Pledge to Rohan
1879254260.desc: Issuing a pledge to the land of Rohan you inspire your war-steed and strengthen your attacks in the process.

1879257972.name: Piercing Trap
1879257972.desc: Places a snare to slow the enemy and cause damage over time.\n\nTrap remains for 60 seconds after being placed.

1879274100.name: Snap Shot - Shield Piercer of Fire
1879274100.desc: Special javelins will pierce a defender's shield and bend, making the javelin difficult to remove and  the shield nearly useless.

1879297396.name: For Rohan!
1879297396.desc: Folca unleashes a powerful spear strike that inflicts incredible damage to a single enemy, but cannot be used often.

1879316852.name: Sixth Sense
1879316852.desc: Places a buff on self and nearby allies that increases evade chance by 10%.

1879320180.name: Serrated Edge (Dual)
1879320180.desc: A vicious, single strike that leaves your enemy bleeding.

1879329780.name: Steed of the Ithilien Winter
1879329780.desc: A horse from the Winter Festival.

1879339124.name: Guide to after-battle Osgiliath
1879339124.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to after-battle Osgiliath.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879342068.name: Return to the Camp of the Host
1879342068.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Host of the West, you're able to quickly return to the Camp of the Host. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879396852.name: Guide to Estolad Lân
1879396852.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Estolad Lân.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879418740.name: Facepaint - Bee
1879418740.desc: Apply facepaint to your cheek with a bee pattern.

1879467252.name: Check-step
1879467252.desc:
Draw your opponent in with a step back, before quickly making an unexpected strike.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay:
 Disengage gains a heal.
 Fore Skills deal greater damage.</rgb>

1879470580.name: Quick Strike
1879470580.desc: A quick strike which leaves your foe bleeding.

1879495284.name: Memory of Mercy
1879495284.desc: A Memory of Mercy can be used to shield an ally, assuming some of their damage yourself.

1879497716.name: Sign of the Wild: Rage
1879497716.desc: Command your pet to attack their target with a wild and damaging attack.\n\nUsing Fire, Frost, and Lightning skills will reduce the active cooldown of this ability.

1879500404.name: Gandalf's Aid
1879500404.desc: Call upon Gandlaf to bolster your Hope in the face of overwhelming despair.\n\nTo use this skill, you must be near Gandalf.

1879528820.name: Prepared: Shadow-spike
1879528820.desc: Servants of the Umbral Pall use wisps of shadow to harm their enemies.

1879533172.name: Treasure Grim
1879533172.desc: Summons a treasure-hoarding grim to accompany you on your adventures.
